title: Noise probability mass formula
statement: Let $Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with at least two elements, and let $-1/(|Omega|-1)le rho le 1$. For any $x,y\inOmega$, the probability assigned to $y$ by the coordinate noise distribution based at $x$ is $(1+(|Omega|-1)rho)/|Omega|$ if $y=x$, and $(1-rho)/|Omega|$ otherwise.
